Building the digital infrastructure for Canada’s carbon economy.

Carbon infrastructure & digital platform

Karbon Kreds

Website & brand direction

  • Brand strategy
  • UX/UI
  • Web development
  • SEO

The challenge

Make a complex carbon-market proposition easier to understand, navigate and act on.

The strategy

Organize the Canadian carbon-market proposition around four pathways: buy credits, sell credits, develop a project and explore investment. Give each route a clear next step and explain market context in plain language.

Design & engineering

The live website combines responsive page design, an interactive Earth, company and team pages, market information and a contact journey. A map introduces representative activity regions without presenting them as verified live transactions.

The delivery

Website design and development, brand direction, deployment and search setup. No commercial uplift or market transaction figures are claimed.
